name: Hit
description: A weapon landing on chitin. A short square thump falling an octave, under a lowpass that opens bright and closes over the same forty milliseconds — so the edge of the thump is the strike and the body under it is the shell giving. A raw square had every harmonic to Nyquist and sounded like every other raw square in the set. Over it a scatter of dry grains that dulls as it goes, brighter and a step louder than before, because the grains are what a phone speaker gets of this: the thump's fundamental sits under 250Hz, where a small speaker has nothing. Three takes, reseeded and rolled, so the three-hundredth hit in a run is not the first one again. Every enemy takes hundreds of these, so it is deliberately the smallest sound in the set.

elite.description: The same strike on something armoured: everything drops well below the ordinary hit and takes half again as long to give, so an elite reads as heavier without a second sound being authored. The grit comes up a step here, because what drops the thump's pitch drops it off a phone entirely, and the grit is what is left.
